sourceTitle: Xocai Irish Cream with Xocai Healthy Dark Chocolate
sourceText:
Xocai Irish Cream with Xocai Healthy Dark Chocolate
By: Adam Paul Green
Published: Friday, September 2, 2011 - 9:51pm

Ingredients




1/2 Cup 	Irish Cream Syrup
2 	        Xocai Healthy Chocolate Nuggets
4 Tbsp 	Irish Whiskey
1 Dollop    Whipped Cream
1 	        Xocai Healthy Chocolate Nugget, grated

Preparation

1 Heat Irish cream syrup. Remove from heat and add Nuggets. Stir until melted. Cool. 2 Mix 2 tbsp. of cream mixture with 2 tbsp. of whiskey and add to 1 cup of hot coffee. Repeat with second cup. Garnish with whipped cream and grated Nugget. 3 Serves 2

About

"Luscious Dark Chocolate" mixed with Irish Cream is a "delicious creamy combination" that you are sure to enjoy!
